entities.summary: Gwilym Meirion Jenkins was a Welsh statistician and systems engineer, born in Gowerton, Swansea, Wales. He is most notable for his pioneering work with George Box on autoregressive moving average models, also called Box–Jenkins models, in time-series analysis.
